WITH sma_10003_cte AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) AS metric_time__day
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __paid_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __partial_refund_order_count
    , CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS __full_refund_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders" orders_source_src_10000
)

SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_10.full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.refund_order_rate) AS refund_order_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(__refund_order_count) AS refund_order_count
    , SUM(__partial_refund_order_count) AS partial_refund_order_count
    , SUM(__full_refund_order_count) AS full_refund_order_count
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    CAST(SUM(__refund_order_count) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(NULLIF(SUM(__paid_order_count), 0) AS DOUBLE) AS refund_order_rate
  FROM sma_10003_cte
  WHERE metric_time__day BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_17

在青禾 2026 年 8 月（2026-08-01 至 2026-08-31）期间，相关退款指标统计如下（统计口径均按原订单下单日期归属）：

- **退款订单数**：4 笔（已支付且存在退款的订单）
- **部分退款订单数**：1 笔（退款金额大于零且小于实付金额）
- **全额退款订单数**：3 笔（实付金额大于零且累计退款金额等于实付金额）
- **退款订单率**：13.33%（退款订单数占支付订单数的比例）
